Danish artist Simon Lindbeej explores interaction and emergence through a kinetic cabinet that brings together magnetism, mirrors and shadow patterns. Developed since 2025, the work turns furniture into a dynamic system where components influence each other, generating shifting visual rhythms and unexpected formations.
